scope: All five frozen claim/citation pairs, all three ordinary body-flow citation keys, bibliography metadata, exact nearby support, active 49-record user-library relevance, non-library primary coverage, and final LaTeX/BibTeX consistency were checked. No priority claim beyond the manuscript's bounded wording is certified.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill search verification: first freeze the complete active claim/citation extraction, then verify each fixed claim sequentially against the local primary Muney PDF, official arXiv, JSTOR issue metadata, and the official Preprints.org full text after running all applicable academic search templates; finish with the bib-reference-audit consistency checker and converged log scan. Sub-agents were not used because this job expressly prohibited them.
